changelog:
## What's New in v1.5.2

### 🎨 Card Color Overhaul (Light Mode)
- Status cards (Module Enabled, WhatsApp, Business) now use frosted light tint in light mode instead of very dark deep greens
- Each card state has a proper light/dark mode variant (Success, Error, Warning, Update)
- Card text and icons are now dark green in light mode for crisp contrast

### 📥 In-App Download Progress
- Tapping Update Available now shows a live progress bar inside the card with percentage & MB downloaded
- Launches installer automatically upon download completion
